title: breakout_2 phone executor made OBSERVABLE and TESTABLE, built once: step captures (server-only, 7-day TTL) + rehearsal drill + real-page fixtures + signed remote exec.js + one refusal alert (operator decision 2026-10-18)
note: [2026-10-18 lane session_01Cqmpr14msnNhk7ZQrmYRfS] OPERATOR (2026-10-18 ~08:00Z popups, relayed by manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao, binding): the guess-per-build loop on one click (#18709 #18775 #18811 #18901) is not acceptable; the app must know what it is doing, record its own actions WITHOUT anything on screen, and show what it did right and wrong. Decided: all five pieces (RECORDING, REHEARSAL drill, REAL-PAGE fixtures, SIGNED REMOTE exec.js, ALERT); captures on the server only, auto-deleted after 7 days, never committed; live breakout_2 trail amends keep trying meanwhile and each refusal alerts the operator with the stop to set by hand. DONE WHEN the drill passes 3x in a row on the operator's phone with captures per step; then the live amend runs on the same logic. PR 1 (claude/phone-capture-store, Tier-2 HOLD): POST /api/bot/prop/phone/capture (per-device bearer) -> <journal dir>/phone_captures/<acct>/<run>/ (bitmap + sanitized DOM, second scrub server-side, bounded), GET /api/diag/phone_captures|phone_capture|phone_capture_file (diag tier), phone_captures_last on /prop/status, ict-phone-capture-purge.timer (daily) + at-most-hourly purge on the POST. Takes over lane BREAKOUT-SHEET-1017's open work (row BREAKOUT-SL-AMEND-CLICK; its last PR #18901 merged, no open PR of its own).
